definitions.explanation: The launching of a rocket, firework, or similar object into the air.
A celebration party held after completing a project, performance, or event.

examples.japanese: ロケット⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{成功|せいこう}した。
{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ{花火|はなび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
プロジェクト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To have a wrap-up party for the project.

notes:
{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ has two main meanings: launching something and a celebration party.

SENSE 1 - LAUNCH:
- ロケットの{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ: rocket launch
- {打|う}ち{上|あ}げ{花火|はなび}: aerial fireworks
- {人工|じんこう}{衛星|えいせい}の{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ: satellite launch

SENSE 2 - WRAP-UP PARTY:
- {打|う}ち{上|あ}げ{会|かい}: after-party
- {公演|こうえん}の{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ: after-performance party
- プロジェクトの{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ: project completion party

RELATED VERB:
- {打|う}ち{上|あ}げる: to launch; to hold a wrap-up party
